quite valid.

deviates from the standard: it might contain comments or trailing commas, use single quotes
, or be cut off because the model hit its length limit. A strict parser
provides a lenient parser and an extraction function for this situation. They are
independent of the strict parser, which remains RFC 8259 conformant.
